ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_advantage_ratio_log_clamped_repaired
ir.intuition: Repaired by adding numerical stability clamps and explicit tensor creation for scalars to avoid internal PyTorch storage_module bug, preserving original advantage ratio with delta_rank and log prob ratio with stable softplus-log operation.
ir.pseudocode:
prob_ratio = exp(clamp(log_prob_w - log_prob_l, min_val))
adv_ratio = 1 + delta_rank * prob_ratio
adv_ratio_stable = adv_ratio + epsilon
loss_raw = -log(softplus(adv_ratio_stable))
loss = mean(weight * loss_raw)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    diff_clamped = ops.clamp(diff, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    prob_ratio = ops.exp(diff_clamped)

    one = lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape)
    adv_ratio = ops.add(one, ops.mul(delta_rank, prob_ratio))
    adv_ratio_stable = ops.add(adv_ratio, lpw.new_full(lpw.shape, eps))

    softplus_val = ops.softplus(adv_ratio_stable)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.log(softplus_val))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)

    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
